method: Read actual production instance world matrices, shared geometry and the rendered indexed terrain after mineral fractures. Base corners and interior points must stay supported. No transform, state, camera, network or LOD mutation; no timing/FPS or visual-conformity claim.

treeFeet.method: Read actual placed French tree geometry and world transforms, caching each actual model local lowest section (minimumY+.01) as in the existing context-tree support. Query actual final indexed land after mineral fractures. This conservative section may include small stem-side vertices; positive clearance is an authoring observation, not an automatic artistic failure. No camera, game, LOD, geometry or root transform mutation.

mountainRocks.method: Actual mineral triangles and full scenery footprints, grounded below the lowest true soil sample; shared rock/snow geometry.
